title: Food contact materials as possible endocrine disruptors for PPARs: a consensus scoring analysis.
journal: International journal of food sciences and nutrition
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和共识打分研究食品接触材料与核受体PPARs配体结合域的相互作用，属于蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究关联度低。
abstract: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors (PPARs), with the alpha, beta/delta and gamma isoforms, are nuclear receptors that control the expression of genes involved in glucose and lipids' metabolism and into inflammatory processes and play a central role in metabolic syndrome. PPARs are a particular class of nuclear receptors because of their larger and more flexible ligand-binding domain with a particular Y shape. As nuclear receptors, PPARs are sensitive to exposure to xenobiotic compounds, called endocrine disruptions, even at low concentrations that could alter their homeostasis. Among these, food contact materials (FCMs), like phthalates, are synthetic compounds able to migrate from packaging to food and represent a significant source of exposure because of the increased use of plastic in the packaging in the last years. Through multiple docking and consensus scoring, we can analyse the ligand-binding domain's chemical and physical features, understand the mechanism of activation and predict the interaction with possible endocrine disruptions with an evaluation of their effects.
abstract_zh: 过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPARs），包括α、β/δ和γ亚型，是核受体，调控参与葡萄糖和脂质代谢及炎症过程的基因表达，并在代谢综合征中发挥核心作用。PPARs是一类特殊的核受体，因其配体结合域更大且更灵活，呈独特的Y形结构。作为核受体，PPARs对暴露于外源性化合物（称为内分泌干扰物）敏感，即使低浓度也可能改变其稳态。其中，食品接触材料（FCMs），如邻苯二甲酸酯，是能够从包装迁移至食品的合成化合物，由于近年来塑料在包装中的使用增加，构成了显著的暴露来源。通过多重对接和共识评分，我们可以分析配体结合域的化学和物理特征，理解激活机制，并预测与可能的内分泌干扰物的相互作用，同时评估其效应。
